body.script: function loadMap(){var c=document.getElementById('mapContainer'),p=document.getElementById('mapPlaceholder');if(p)p.style.display='none';var f=document.createElement('iframe');f.setAttribute('allowfullscreen','');f.setAttribute('referrerpolicy','no-referrer-when-downgrade');f.setAttribute('title','Peta Lokasi Fajar Desain Grafis, Jakarta Timur');f.style.cssText='position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;border-radius:20px;';f.src='https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m14!1m8!1m3!1d15865.399075282572!2d106.945587!3d-6.2175219!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x2e698d001b23608b%3A0x32f94294467aff02!2sFAJAR%20DESAIN%20GRAFIS!5e0!3m2!1sid!2sid!4v1771775553790!5m2!1sid!2sid';c.appendChild(f);} (function(){var el=document.getElementById('mapPlaceholder');if(!el||!('IntersectionObserver' in window))return;var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){entries.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){loadMap();obs.disconnect();}});},{threshold:0.3});obs.observe(el);})();
